svg.text: Current measured/photo-context model rendered for visual feedback. Approximate elements remain labelled in metadata.

polygon.title: property_boundary; dimensioned_from_legacy_site_plan; Overall site boundary from Matplotlib-005 property dimensions. Boundary position is schematic until cadastral/survey data is added.
boundary_hedges_and_fences; photo_verified_approx; Photo-verified tall hedges/fences along the driveway side and rear/side garden boundaries. These are important shade and privacy constraints.
boundary_hedges_and_fences; photo_verified_approx; Photo-verified tall hedges/fences along the driveway side and rear/side garden boundaries. These are important shade and privacy constraints.

upper_side_driveway; satellite_photo_verified_approx; Satellite/photo-verified main concrete driveway running from the street side along the upper side of the property toward the garage. Replaces the earlier generic path polygon.
front_diagonal_path; satellite_photo_verified_approx; Satellite-visible diagonal concrete path from the driveway/front hardscape toward the sunroom/front-house area.

garage_concrete_pad; satellite_photo_verified_approx; Satellite/photo-verified larger concrete area in front of the garage/cottage line where the driveway/service area opens out. The house-side edge now meets the timber deck's sloping outer edge, matching photos where the deck steps directly onto concrete rather than grass. Edges are approximate pending direct measurements.

garage_cottage_side_path; photo_verified_approx; Photo-verified narrow concrete path running along the house-facing side of the cottage and garage, meeting the larger concrete area. This replaces the incorrect broad rear concrete block.

sunroom_front_steps; photo_verified_approx; Photo-verified dark timber steps/landing outside the angled sunroom double doors. The treads span the full angled doorway and project outward slightly toward the front path; direct step depth measurements would improve this.

sunroom_front_steps; photo_verified_approx; Photo-verified dark timber steps/landing outside the angled sunroom double doors. The treads span the full angled doorway and project outward slightly toward the front path; direct step depth measurements would improve this.

sunroom_front_steps; photo_verified_approx; Photo-verified dark timber steps/landing outside the angled sunroom double doors. The treads span the full angled doorway and project outward slightly toward the front path; direct step depth measurements would improve this.

rear_timber_deck; photo_verified_approx; Photo-verified timber deck outside the kitchen/dining double doors and entrance/laundry side of the house. Updated from House-Outline-Internal-walls-deck.png and the 2026-05-14 deck measurement markup. The lower-right notch is scaled from the marked measurements: 0.37m upper return, 0.86m angled step, 2.35m outer side, and 0.51m lower return anchored from the laundry exterior wall. Latest correction lifts the notch so the lower return starts about 1cm below the entrance/laundry front-wall line and sets the top-left house-side deck point 20cm below the dining room external corner. Geometry remains approximate until the full deck perimeter is measured.

rect.title: cottage_end_deck; photo_verified_approx; Photo-verified small deck/landing at the end of the cottage. Position and size are approximate until measured.

garage_shed; photo_verified_approx; Photo-verified remaining garage/shed at the end of the driveway with visible roller door. Current model places it on the same horizontal line and width as the cottage, with only a small gap to the top boundary.

cottage; photo_verified_satellite_outdated; Photo-verified cottage added after the satellite image was taken. The cottage sits to the right of the garage on the same horizontal line and approximate width, replacing part of the old rear garage footprint. Display geometry is approximate until measured or newer aerial imagery is available.

polygon.title: sunroom; measured_approx; First current-structure slice: measured sunroom shape with photo-verified wraparound glazing. Display geometry was redrawn from the direct 5.02m Hallway/Sunroom-to-NW-window and 4.07m Lounge/Sunroom-to-west-window checks while preserving the accepted lounge slider position. The 5.02m sunroom span is retained as a measured check but is not treated as a vertical projection, so the NW/top sunroom edge stays roughly level with and just below the lounge external wall.

rect.title: lounge; measured_dimensions_inferred_position; Included only to anchor the photo-verified sunroom-to-lounge slider relationship. The sunroom-side wall is shifted right so the clear lounge width reads as the measured 3.70m while the kitchen/dining divider stays fixed. The north external wall is pushed outward so the lounge clear depth reads as the measured 4.90m.

polygon.title: kitchen_dining; measured_dimensions_photo_verified_openings; Promoted after deck-side photos verified the large door group and adjacent glazing. Lower-left vinyl flooring now continues down to the hallway/entrance line to avoid the old notch in the rendered floor surface, while the left boundary below the dining external wall is pulled back to the kitchen/lounge divider line so hard flooring does not creep into the lounge or hallway. The north dining external wall is pushed outward so the clear span from the Bedroom 2 entrance to the dining end wall reads as the remeasured 8.12m.

entrance; measured_dimensions_photo_verified; Photo-verified glazed deck-side entrance/back-entry space connected to laundry. Display geometry now follows the updated measured chain: 2.52m from the entrance/laundry opening line back to the narrowing point, then 1.13m left to the inside of the kitchen door frame before the entrance widens by 0.25m. The return wall remains recorded at 130mm thick.

rect.title: laundry; measured_dimensions_photo_verified; Photo-verified laundry beyond entrance with washing machines, sink/bench, and exterior window. Display top edge is aligned to the deck-side entrance internal line. The Bedroom 2/laundry wall is shifted left so the laundry/toilet clear internal width is 1.80m, with the lower divider reset from the remeasured stack so the laundry clear height is about 3.03m.

toilet; measured_dimensions_photo_verified; Photo-verified small toilet room connected from laundry with frosted exterior window. The Bedroom 2/laundry wall is shifted left so the laundry/toilet clear internal width is 1.80m. The bottom exterior wall strip is remeasured as 270mm, and the laundry/toilet divider preserves the remeasured 0.91m toilet clear depth.

polygon.title: hallway; measured_dimensions_photo_verified; Photo-verified interior circulation spine connecting lounge/office side toward entrance and laundry, with bathroom sliding door visible on the side wall. Display floor footprint stops at the kitchen wall line so carpet does not overlay the vinyl flooring continuation at the entrance/kitchen corner.

rect.title: master_bedroom; measured_dimensions_reference_position_photo_context; Measured room dimensions promoted into the current layer as clear floor area. The 0.62m-deep built-in wardrobe is a separate bay between the master bedroom and office rather than space taken from the master floor area. Pixel width was recalibrated against the adjacent office/bathroom/Bedroom 2 row so the 3.3m clear master width is represented consistently. Pixel position remains photo-context checked against master bedroom photos and exterior street/front views.

office; measured_dimensions_reference_position_photo_context; Measured room dimensions promoted into the current layer. Pixel position is shifted right by the 0.62m master wardrobe bay so the office clear dimensions remain intact while the wardrobe sits between the master bedroom and office.

bathroom; measured_dimensions_reference_position_photo_context; Measured bathroom dimensions promoted into the current layer. Pixel position is shifted right with the office-side private-room row after adding the 0.62m master wardrobe bay. The bathroom/Bedroom 2 divider is nudged left slightly so Bedroom 2 renders to its remeasured 4.73m internal length.

bedroom_2; measured_dimensions_reference_position_photo_context; Measured room dimensions promoted into the current layer. The east wall is shifted left to widen the laundry/toilet bay to 1.80m clear internal width, and the bathroom divider is nudged left so the room renders to the remeasured 4.73m internal length.

polygon.title: sunroom wall outline
kitchen_dining wall outline
entrance wall outline
hallway wall outline

g.title: Dining table and four chairs visible in dining photos.
Kitchen benches, blue cabinetry, pantry/fridge wall, and sink/cooktop run are visible in kitchen photos.
L-shaped lounge sofa pulled off the lower wall to leave a circulation gap behind it, plus coffee table and TV/media wall visible in lounge photos.
Master bed and headboard visible against the dark feature wall.
Bedroom 2 photos show bed/daybed along the pink feature wall with storage/bookcase and open wardrobe on the opposite side.
Office desk, chair, screens, and shelving visible in office photos.
Laundry bench, sink, and two front-loading appliances visible in laundry photos.
Two cars shown because the user confirmed the garage can be represented with two cars.
Small outdoor table/chairs and wicker seating visible on the deck photos.

polygon.title: sunroom_lounge_slider; photo_verified; Position updated from user measurement: across the lounge/sunroom wall the sequence is 0.86m wall return, 3.15m slider, then 0.86m wall return, so the slider is centred on that wall span. Pixel geometry is distributed across the current rendered wall span.

sunroom_wraparound_glazing; photo_verified; Wraparound glazing redrawn with the west window inside edge tied to the direct sunroom span measurement. The NW/top glazing is visually constrained to sit roughly level with the lounge external wall because the 5.02m sunroom check is not a pure vertical projection in plan view.

sunroom_wraparound_glazing; photo_verified; Wraparound glazing redrawn with the west window inside edge tied to the direct sunroom span measurement. The NW/top glazing is visually constrained to sit roughly level with the lounge external wall because the 5.02m sunroom check is not a pure vertical projection in plan view.

sunroom_wraparound_glazing; photo_verified; Wraparound glazing redrawn with the west window inside edge tied to the direct sunroom span measurement. The NW/top glazing is visually constrained to sit roughly level with the lounge external wall because the 5.02m sunroom check is not a pure vertical projection in plan view.

sunroom_wraparound_glazing; photo_verified; Wraparound glazing redrawn with the west window inside edge tied to the direct sunroom span measurement. The NW/top glazing is visually constrained to sit roughly level with the lounge external wall because the 5.02m sunroom check is not a pure vertical projection in plan view.

sunroom_front_double_doors; visual_reference; The angled face to the front path is photo-verified as paired glazed doors. It is rendered separately from the fixed sunroom glazing so the opening reads like the other double-door symbols.

lounge_north_left_window; measured_position_photo_context; Measured small north-wall lounge window. User measured it as 0.42m wide, starting 0.32m in from the internal left corner, not the exterior wall centreline.

lounge_north_right_window; measured_position_photo_context; Measured small north-wall lounge window. User measured it as 0.42m wide, starting 0.32m in from the internal right corner of the projecting nub, noted as 0.47m.

deck_door_group; photo_verified; Measured deck-side double doors below the short deck-side window, separated by a 0.12m wall section. Sequence from the top-right inside kitchen/dining corner is 1.14m to the window, 0.57m window, 0.12m wall, then 1.62m double doors.

deck_side_dining_window; measured_position_photo_context; Measured short deck-side kitchen/dining window above the double doors. It starts 1.14m below the top-right inside corner and is 0.57m wide along the deck-side wall.

dining_west_window; measured_position_photo_context; Measured dining-room west/left-wall window. User remeasured it as 0.66m long, starting 0.32m down from the dining-room internal corner. Shifted with the west external wall so the external wall inner face aligns with the kitchen/lounge divider face.

entrance_deck_slider; photo_verified; Photo-verified deck-side glazed entrance/slider. User remeasured it as 1.47m wide, starting 0.28m from the inside wall corner where the entrance narrows. Rendered on the 140mm deck-side entrance wall using the local 810mm internal-door scale.

entrance_to_laundry_opening; photo_verified; User-measured 740mm opening between the entrance and laundry. Display geometry is centred within the 1.16m entrance depth, leaving about 0.21m of wall nub above and below the opening.

laundry_north_window; measured_position_photo_context; Measured wide laundry window over the bench/sink on the deck-side/top wall. User measured it as 1.38m wide and 0.22m from the top-right/north corner.
laundry_east_window; measured_position_photo_context; Measured laundry side-wall window on the right/east exterior wall. User measured it as 1.10m wide and 0.95m from the top-right/north corner.

laundry_to_toilet_door; photo_verified; Photo-verified narrower internal door from laundry into the toilet. Updated to the measured 588mm width, shifted closer to the west side wall without touching it, with the hinge on the left/west jamb and the swing arc following the door leaf into the toilet.
toilet_frosted_window; measured_position_photo_context; Measured compact frosted toilet window, 0.52m wide and centred on the toilet east wall.

hallway_to_entrance_laundry; photo_verified; Photo-verified hallway continuation toward the entrance/laundry end. Display geometry now aligns with the kitchen wall/opening line so vinyl flooring does not bleed into the carpeted hallway.

kitchen_dining_to_bedroom2_door; photo_verified; Photo-verified standard internal door on the northwest side of Bedroom 2, connecting back to the kitchen/dining circulation edge. Rendered at the measured 810mm internal-door scale and opening into Bedroom 2.

entrance_to_kitchen_dining_door; photo_verified; Photo-verified internal door between the kitchen/dining area and the narrow entrance/back-entry space. Updated to the user's measured 730mm width and rendered locally at 19.8px on the recalibrated entrance/kitchen return wall. Its frame position now follows the measured entrance chain: 2.52m from the entrance/laundry opening line to the narrowing point, then 1.13m back to this kitchen door frame. It is centred vertically within the measured narrow entrance wall and opens from the entrance into the kitchen/dining side.

hallway_to_lounge_door; photo_verified; Photo-verified doorway between the hallway and lounge. User measured the right-hand jamb as 1.41m from the north hallway corner beside the kitchen entrance, making the doorway roughly centred on the lounge/hallway wall. Rendered at the measured 810mm internal-door scale, with the leaf hinged on the lounge-side/east jamb and opening into the lounge. Its display centerline is slightly lowered so the hallway-side edge of the thinner internal wall aligns visually with the adjacent old external wall.

hallway_to_sunroom_old_front_door; measured_user_confirmed; User-confirmed old front door between the hallway and sunroom. It is 770mm wide, its frame sits tight to the master-bedroom entrance side, and it opens into the hallway toward the master bedroom. The rendered wall is split at this opening rather than drawing the previous short continuous wall segment.

hallway_to_kitchen_dining_door; photo_verified; Photo-verified door between the hallway and kitchen/dining area. Its opening lines up with the lounge/kitchen divider wall and is centered vertically within that short wall run. Latest measurement anchors the Bedroom 2 doorway-to-kitchen wall gap at 0.59m, so the lounge/sunroom divider and connected kitchen/deck slice move right together. It opens into the hallway, with the open leaf parallel to the hallway's northern wall.

hallway_to_bathroom_sliding_door; photo_verified; Photo-verified bathroom pocket/sliding door opening off the hallway. Rendered with a pocket-door panel and wall recess marker; exact lateral placement remains approximate until a hallway wall survey.

hallway_to_master_bedroom_door; photo_verified; Photo-verified master bedroom door off the hallway. Door swings into the master bedroom from the lower/south jamb, matching the open door visible against the wardrobe side in master-bedroom photos.

hallway_to_office_door; photo_verified; Photo-verified office doorway relationship to the hallway. Opening sits on the right-hand side of the office's hallway wall, leaving the wall continuous to the left. Reduced to a standard internal-door scale based on the hallway and office photos; swing is into the office from the east/right jamb.
master_street_window; measured_position_photo_context; Street/front-facing master bedroom window marker updated from direct user measurement: 2.15m wide and 1.04m from the top-left/west corner.

master_sunroom_window; measured_position_photo_context; Master bedroom window facing the sunroom side. This sits in the original external wall before the sunroom was added, so it is rendered with the exterior-window symbol. User measured it as 2.14m wide and centred.

master_rear_high_window; measured_position_photo_context; Rear/south high window in the master bedroom above the bed headboard. Position updated from direct user measurement: it is centred on the rear wall with 1.32m clearance on both sides.

office_se_window; measured_position_photo_context; Measured SE-facing office window marker. User corrected it to 1.07m wide, with about 0.87m clear wall either side. Current office clear width is retained at 2.90m, so the display centres the window on the office wall and leaves about 0.92m each side until the office width is rechecked.
bathroom_se_window; measured_position_photo_context; Measured SE-facing bathroom window marker. User measured it as 1.10m wide and centred on the wall.
bedroom2_se_window; measured_position_photo_context; Measured SE-facing bedroom 2 window marker. User measured it as 2.00m wide and centred.

bedroom2_entrance_internal_window; measured_position_photo_context; Measured internal window in the wall between Bedroom 2 and the entrance. User measured it as 0.9m long, with the right edge 1.02m from the right-hand wall.

svg.text: Approximate/reference-positioned items: 14. Use this plan for visual feedback, not construction documentation.
